# FactorMiner: A Self-Evolving Agent with Skills and Experience Memory for Financial Alpha Discovery

arXiv [2602.14670](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14670) · v1 2026-02-16 · latest 2026-08-19

| Field | Gloss | Quote from the paper |
|---|---|---|
| **task** | Automated discovery of interpretable, low-redundancy formulaic alpha factors for quantitative investment using a self-evolving LLM agent. | “We propose FactorMiner, a lightweight and flexible self-evolving agent framework designed to navigate this complex landscape through continuous knowledge accumulation.” |
| **architecture** | LLM agent running a Ralph Loop (retrieve, generate, evaluate, distill). Its tools are a modular factor-mining skill (60+ GPU-accelerated operators, multi-stage IC/correlation validation pipeline) and an experience memory of successful and forbidden patterns. A factor library grows under correlation constraints with a replacement step. | “FactorMiner combines a Modular Skill Architecture that encapsulates systematic financial evaluation into executable tools with a structured Experience Memory that distills historical mining trials into actionable insights (successful patterns and failure constraints).” |
| **data** | Intraday 10-minute bars of CSI 500, CSI 1000 and CSI 300 constituents (A-shares), plus 10-minute bars of 64 major Binance crypto assets. Target is the next-step 10-minute return. | “For A-share equities, we utilize intraday 10-minute bars of three index universes: the CSI 500 and CSI 1000 index constituents for mid-cap and broader small-/mid-cap coverage, and the CSI 300 index constituents for large-cap representation” |
| **window** | Training 2024-Q1 to 2024-Q4, held-out test in 2025. Top-40 factors are selected on CSI500 2024. An extra robustness check on CSI500 runs through 2026-03. | “All datasets cover a training period from 2024-Q1 to 2024-Q4 and a held-out test period in 2025.” |
| **models** | Gemini 3.0 Flash generates the factor proposals, with no fine-tuning. XGBoost and Lasso are used for downstream factor selection. | “For methods that require LLM-based proposal generation, we use Gemini 3.0 Flash unless otherwise stated. We do not fine-tune or update the LLM weights” |
| **baselines** | Alpha101 Classic, Alpha101 Adapted, Random Formula Exploration, GPLearn, AlphaForge, AlphaAgent and a No Memory ablation. End-to-end forecasters PatchTST, Chronos-2 and LightGBM are also compared. | “We compare against six representative methods: (1) Alpha101 (Classic) (Kakushadze, 2016), a static library of hand-crafted formulas; (2) Alpha101 (Adapted), with parameters tuned for high-frequency data; (3) Random Formula Exploration (RF)” |
| **headline_result** | Top-40 factor library on CSI500 in the 2025 out-of-sample period: IC 8.25%, ICIR 0.77. Equal-weight combination: IC 14.95, ICIR 1.29. | “In the Factor Library setting, it achieves IC/ICIR of 8.25%/0.77 on CSI500, with similar competitive improvements on the other markets (see Table 1).” |
| **costs** | No transaction costs are modeled; transaction-cost-aware backtesting is left for future work. | “Our pipeline also targets predictive IC, ICIR, redundancy, and portfolio diagnostics, with transaction-cost-aware deployment left for future work.” |
| **uncertainty** | *not found in the text provided* | |
| **leakage_controls** | Factors are selected once on 2024 data and frozen for 2025 evaluation. Combination weights and signs are also fixed on 2024. The held-out test period is 2025. | “Table 1 reports 2025 out-of-sample results under a strict protocol: Top-40 factors are selected once on CSI500 (2024) and then frozen for evaluation on multiple datasets.” |
| **limitations** | End-to-end baselines were not exhaustively tuned. There is no transaction-cost-aware deployment. The factors could be misused in speculative or manipulative strategies. | “Although we include comparisons with end-to-end models, these baselines are not exhaustively tuned and remain less interpretable than formulaic factors.” |
| **release** | The 110 A-share factor formulas are released and listed in the appendix. No code repository is given. | “We provide 110 A-share equity factors with explicit formulaic expressions, validated on real market data.” |
